newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbek 1997 raw cotton harvest seen at four mln T.
newsitem.headline: Uzbek 1997 raw cotton harvest seen at four mln T.

text.p: Uzbekistan plans to raise its 1997 raw cotton harvest to four million tonnes from 1996's weather-hit 3.35 million tonnes, an official from the Agriculture Ministry told Reuters on Thursday.
He said that cotton would be sown over a total area of 1.5 million hectares, but gave no details of prices cotton growers would be paid by the state.
According to estimates from the International Cotton Advisory Committee (ICAC), Uzbekistan was the world's fifth largest producer in 1995 with total output of 1.25 million tonnes of cotton fibre.
It was also the second largest exporter with 1.05 million tonnes of cotton sold abroad.

At an ICAC plenary session in the Uzbek capital of Tashkent last autumn, President Islam Karimov said his country was firmly committed to retaining its position as the second biggest exporter of cotton fibre.
